summary: The grade 6 capstone of Positive Action's elementary Bible series: 35 weekly lessons, each in three sessions, built on the image of running the Christian race. It mixes Old and New Testament character studies (Josiah, Gideon, Samuel, Absalom, John the Baptist, Ahab and Jezebel, Peter) with a review of New Testament doctrine: the life and work of Christ, the Holy Spirit, the church, and a closing unit on Revelation and last things.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Preparation
toc.covers: A call to study God's Word with humility and determination, with emphasis on the good news of Christ (Lessons 1-3).

children.label: Lesson 1
children.title: The Word of God
children.covers: Overview of the Bible's testaments, books and genres, its single message from one Author, and Jesus as the living Word.

children.label: Lesson 2
children.title: Seeking God's Word
children.covers: Biblical pictures of Scripture and young King Josiah's humble response when God's Law was rediscovered.

children.label: Lesson 3
children.title: Listening to God
children.covers: God answering Moses' doubts (Exodus 3-4), Jonah's lesson in mercy, and true obedience versus lip service.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: Inner Strength
toc.covers: Attitudes that reflect confidence in God (Lessons 4-8).

children.label: Lesson 4
children.title: Designed for His Glory
children.covers: God's knowledge of each person and Gideon's call and victory over Midian (Judges 6-7); courage and fear.

children.label: Lesson 5
children.title: God's Purpose for Me
children.covers: Glorifying God, following Christ, and sanctification as growth in Christlikeness.

children.label: Lesson 6
children.title: Filled with the Spirit
children.covers: Christ's promise of the Spirit, the fruit of the Spirit versus the flesh (Galatians 5), and Paul and Silas in prison at Philippi.

children.label: Lesson 7
children.title: Our Worship to God
children.covers: Praise, sincere rather than outward worship, and Mary's song after learning she would bear the Messiah.

children.label: Lesson 8
children.title: Repenting from Sin
children.covers: Putting off the old self (Ephesians 4), repentance as turning back to God, and forgiving others as God forgives.

children.label: Lesson 9
children.title: Path of the Righteous
children.covers: The two ways of Psalm 1, Lot's choices and escape from Sodom, and guarding against bad influences.

children.label: Lesson 10
children.title: Honor and Obedience
children.covers: The Fifth Commandment and Ephesians 6, Samuel's obedience to Eli, and submission as an expression of love.

children.label: Lesson 11
children.title: To Help or Rebel
children.covers: Absalom's rebellion against David and his death, contrasted with Jonathan's loyal support of Saul.

children.label: Lesson 12
children.title: A Heart for God
children.covers: Sin coming from the heart, wholehearted devotion, Christ's teaching on hypocrisy, and the abominations of Proverbs 6.

children.label: Lesson 13
children.title: A Life of Dedication
children.covers: The birth and ministry of John the Baptist and abiding in Christ the true vine (John 15).

children.label: Lesson 14
children.title: Courage to Stand
children.covers: John baptizing Jesus, John's doubts, imprisonment and death, and the persecution Jesus foretold for his followers.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: Weights and Distractions
toc.covers: Desires and influences that distract from God (Lessons 15-21).

children.label: Lesson 15
children.title: Foolishness
children.covers: Wisdom and folly in Proverbs, Ahab and Jezebel's rejection of God, and Elijah's contest on Mount Carmel.

children.label: Lesson 16
children.title: Greed and Envy
children.covers: Naboth's vineyard, the judgment on Ahab and Jezebel, and coveting versus contentment.

children.label: Lesson 17
children.title: Enemies of God
children.covers: Satan, the flesh, and the world system as sources of temptation.

children.label: Lesson 18
children.title: How We Sin
children.covers: Eve and the serpent, sin as breaking God's law, and Jesus resisting Satan's temptations with Scripture.

children.label: Lesson 19
children.title: Overcoming Temptation
children.covers: Peter's denial and restoration, temptation as a test of faith, and the armor of God (Ephesians 6).

children.label: Lesson 20
children.title: Conformed to His Image
children.covers: The new person (Colossians 3), the body as the Spirit's temple (1 Corinthians 6), and believers as Christ's ambassadors (2 Corinthians 5).

children.label: Lesson 21
children.title: The Church in the World
children.covers: Themes of 1 Corinthians: unity in Christ, conscience and weaker believers, and spiritual gifts in one body.

toc.label: Unit 5
toc.title: The Goal
toc.covers: A review of Christ's teaching and ministry (Lessons 22-28).

children.label: Lesson 22
children.title: The Lamb of God
children.covers: Old Testament sacrifice, Abraham and Isaac on Mount Moriah, the Passover lamb, and Christ as the final sacrifice.

children.label: Lesson 23
children.title: The Miracles of Jesus
children.covers: Kinds of miracles, where Jesus ministered in Israel, and how people responded.

children.label: Lesson 24
children.title: A New Life in Christ
children.covers: The Samaritan woman (John 4), the Bread of Life teaching (John 6), and the kingdom of heaven.

children.label: Lesson 25
children.title: The Sermon on the Mount
children.covers: The Beatitudes, love as the fulfilment of the Law, and the Lord's Prayer and forgiveness (Matthew 5-6).

children.label: Lesson 26
children.title: The Crucifixion
children.covers: Jesus' foreknowledge of his death, his innocence at trial, and his suffering on the cross.

children.label: Lesson 27
children.title: The Resurrection
children.covers: The physical resurrection, Jesus' appearances, the ascension, and the Great Commission (Matthew 28).

children.label: Lesson 28
children.title: The Power of the Spirit
children.covers: Pentecost, Peter's new boldness, and the Spirit given to Gentiles through Cornelius.

toc.label: Unit 6
toc.title: The Prize
toc.covers: An introduction to eschatology through the Book of Revelation (Lessons 29-35).

children.label: Lesson 29
children.title: Revealing the Future
children.covers: God's sovereignty, fulfilled prophecy, why Revelation was written, and Genesis themes completed in Revelation.

children.label: Lesson 30
children.title: Messages from the Son
children.covers: John's vision of the glorified Christ, the letters to the seven churches, and the spread of the early church.

children.label: Lesson 31
children.title: The Church in Heaven
children.covers: Believers caught up to Christ (1 Corinthians, 1 Thessalonians 4), the judgment seat of Christ, and the throne room of Revelation.

children.label: Lesson 32
children.title: Judging the World
children.covers: The Day of the Lord, the judgments of the Tribulation, and the Antichrist.

children.label: Lesson 33
children.title: The Reign of Christ
children.covers: God's patience, the Battle of Armageddon (Revelation 19-20), and Christ's reign on earth after his return.

children.label: Lesson 34
children.title: The Final Victory
children.covers: Satan's final defeat, the Great White Throne judgment, and visions of eternity with God.

children.label: Lesson 35
children.title: Review
children.covers: Review of Units 1-6, course vocabulary, and the themes of Revelation.

notes: Each lesson has three sessions (A, B, C) whose titles appear in the scope and sequence; the 'covers' lines fold those in. Optional parts include a Scripture memory track (Psalm 119, Galatians 5, Proverbs 3, James 1, Philippians 2, 1 Thessalonians 4), a character trait for each lesson, and a hymn sung across several lessons. Ten-point quizzes are given for Lessons 1-34. Unit 6 teaches a futurist reading of Revelation: believers caught up to Christ, a Tribulation, an Antichrist, Armageddon, and Christ's earthly reign before the final judgment. A teacher from a different eschatological tradition may want to frame that unit.
